name: FadeMC [1.21.4-26.3]
description:
Welcome to FadeMC — a never-resetting survival world where your builds, loot, and legacy are permanent. We blend classic Minecraft adventure with deep custom content: 200+ unique items, custom mines with scaling progression and rare drops, and a thriving player economy — all wrapped in a grief-free, no-pressure environment.

Claim your land, build without fear, and explore a world that never resets. Your inventory is safe on death, your builds are protected, and your progress stays forever. Whether you're diving into mines for exclusive loot, crafting one-of-a-kind gear, or teaming up with friends across Java and Bedrock, FadeMC is built for players who want to actually stick around.

Cross-play enabled — Java + Bedrock players share the same world, the same spawn, the same economy. No pay-to-win. No seasonal wipes. No anxiety about losing your stuff. Just a solid SMP with real depth, real systems, and a community that sticks.

Ready your pickaxe. Your story starts at fademc.gg.
